onboarding.procedure: For deliberate onboarding, stop and upgrade older writers on every host, review all sources and durable paths, explicitly claim each filesystem source using its fresh admin_state, inspect status again, then explicitly activate with --confirm-quiesced and a fresh admin_state. A claim alone fences legacy sync; finish activation before ordinary writes or sync. This inspection never claims, activates, repairs or switches to database-only storage.
